bind_host.description: The IP address or hostname the EventSource server binds to. Use `0.0.0.0` to accept connections from all interfaces.

port.description: TCP port on which the EventSource server listens for client connections.

max_connections.description: Maximum number of concurrent WebSocket connections the server will accept.

log_dir.description: Directory where server logs will be written. Ensure the directory is writable by the service user.

log_level.description: Verbosity of logs. Choose from DEBUG, INFO, WARNING, ERROR, or CRITICAL.

pagure_uri.description: Base URL of the main Pagure web instance (used for reverse proxy checks, health endpoints, or API calls).

idle_timeout.description: Number of seconds after which an idle WebSocket connection is closed.

use_tls.description: Enable TLS encryption for the EventSource connections (recommended for production deployments).

tls_cert.description: Path to the TLS certificate file. Required if `use_tls` is enabled.

tls_key.description: Path to the TLS private key file. Required if `use_tls` is enabled.

allowed_origins.description: List of allowed origins for WebSocket connections (for CORS). Use `['*']` to allow all, or specify domains like `['https://pagure.example.com']` for stricter security.

redis_url.description: URL of the Redis instance used for inter-process coordination and event broadcasting across multiple worker nodes.

workers.description: Number of worker processes. Set to 0 for automatic scaling based on available CPU cores.

local_db_path.description: Path to the local SQLite database used as a fallback state store (e.g., for reconnect state when Redis is unavailable).

debug.description: Enable verbose debugging mode. Disable in production as it may expose sensitive details.
